1. (Currently amended) A cosmetic composition comprising an indole compound of formula I:

[Formula I structure]

wherein:
R1 is hydrogen or C1-C4 alkyl;
R2 is hydrogen, C1-C4 alkyl, or halogen;
R3 is hydrogen or C1-C4 alkyl;
R4 is hydrogen, C1-C4 alkyl, or C1-C4 alkoxy;
R5 is hydrogen or C1-C4 alkyl;

__wherein the indole compound is present in an amount effective for treating skin conditions associated with defective keratinisation__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Currently amended) Composition according to claim 1 or 3, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine __in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight__.

6. (Previously presented) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight.

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for treating skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation__.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation __wherein the treatment comprises topical application of the composition to affected skin areas__.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle __treatment__.

10. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care __or__ improvement of the general state of the skin or hair __wherein the use comprises topical application__.

11. (Previously presented) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening __comprising topical application of the composition__.

13. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin __comprising topical application__.

14. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for __reducing__ time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair __comprising topical application of the active ingredient__.
